title: Autopay Record Reduction of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Return Fee
content:
Customers who paid their Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract through autopay have the return fee reduced. The count is the balloon payments posted through the autopay ACH channel in the 12 calendar months ending on the billing date.

| Autopay payments posted in the 12 months | Reduction of the return fee |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | USD 40.00 |
| 6 to 9 | USD 20.00 |
| 5 or fewer | None |

Payments through any other channel, such as online ACH or the automated phone line, are not counted. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the billing date takes in the dates on or before the billing date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

*Hypothetical:* 9 autopay payments and 3 online payments in the window: 9 autopay payments, USD 20.00.
